broadcasts.message: normalize.js final and correct. NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapse to single space, trim. No extra modifications. All components compatible. Project complete.

Final tokenizer.js confirmed. tokenize(text) calls injected normalize(text), then extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes using regex /[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:'[A-Za-z0-9]+)*/g. Returns array in input order, empty array for no matches. No shadowing of normalize. All peers aligned. Project complete.

Pipeline finalized. processText calls injected tokenize, builds null-prototype frequencies, tracks first-seen unique tokens, and returns the exact required object. Handles empty tokens, repetition, and prototype names safely. All peers compatible.
